name: Ultraman 80
description: Takeshi Yamato, a twenty-two-year-old young man lives a double life. During the daytime, he is a rookie but popular science teacher at a junior high school in Tokyo. But after school and on Sundays he works as a member of the elite UGM (Utility Government Members).

videos.title: Ultraman Teacher
videos.overview: As signs of monsters appear, Takeshi Yamato gains a new job as a science teacher. However, a menace is approaching his school.

videos.title: The Teacher's Secret
videos.overview: Tsukamoto, a student in Yamato's class, has stopped coming to school. Takeshi vows to find out why.

videos.title: Don't Cry, First Love Monster
videos.overview: Shinichi is heartbroken after losing his girlfriend to another boy. Will his resentment grow so great, it becomes a monster?

videos.title: From The Sky With Love
videos.overview: Super is unhappy about his sister's impending marriage. A monster appears, behaving as immaturely as Super.

videos.title: The Phantom Town
videos.overview: The Bam Aliens scheme to defeat Ultraman 80 by spiriting him away into four-dimensional space. Can UGM help him return?

videos.title: The Boy From The Stars
videos.overview: Akio believes that he's an alien from another planet, not a human boy. Can Takeshi help Akio understand the truth?

videos.title: Operation Silent Tokyo
videos.overview: A plane crashes after its engines go silent. UGM investigates, suspecting monster activity.

videos.title: The Resurrected Legend
videos.overview: UGM is investigating a mountain where Takeshi's class is going for a field trip. Legends say a monster is sealed in the mountain...

videos.title: Airport Emergency!
videos.overview: The head teacher wants to arrange a marriage for Kyoko. Takeshi wants to put a stop to it, but a monster's appearances keep interfering with his plans.

videos.title: Visitor From Space
videos.overview: Takeshi's childhood friend Alma visits Earth. She plays pranks on his students, who take her tricks too seriously.

videos.title: Dreadful Gas Panic
videos.overview: A small monster arrives and is quickly destroyed. However, an innocent-looking shell may cause more damage than realized.

videos.title: The Beautiful Transfer Student
videos.overview: A beautiful young girl joins Takeshi's class. Hiroshi falls in love with her, but where is she really from?

videos.title: Knockout! Formation Yamato!
videos.overview: The Caps of other UGM branches are being mysteriously assassinated. And Japan's Cap has been accused of murder!

videos.title: Teleportation! The Man From Paris
videos.overview: Chief Itou comes to Japan to join UGM. He seems too good to be true, but puts the officers through harsh training.

videos.title: The Demon Doctor's Laboratory
videos.overview: Sera, UGM's head of PR, wants to save a baby monster. But the scientist Nakagawa wants to use the monster in his experiments.

videos.title: The Mysterious Snow Art from Space
videos.overview: UGM investigates the beautiful space artifact, Snow Art. They decipher a warning left by the Ruriya Aliens, but too late.

videos.title: Fly To The Sinister Monster Island!!, Part 1
videos.overview: A group of UGM officers goes to investigate Shiokaze Island. Although the island is a vacation spot, the officers find it deserted.

videos.title: Fly To The Sinister Monster Island!!, Part 2
videos.overview: Takeshi and the UGM officers try to track down a mysterious woman who seems to be able to control monsters. Is she friend or foe?

videos.title: Order To Destroy The Rogue Star
videos.overview: The rogue star Red Rose is on a collision course with Earth. UGM plans to save Earth by using nuclear weapons to destroy Red Rose in space.

videos.title: Invasion!! The Bloodsucking Ball Army
videos.overview: After a spaceship crash, UGM finds the bodies of those aboard drained of blood. And now, the blood-sucking balls are attacking Earth!

videos.title: Shine Into Eternity!! Space G-Men 85
videos.overview: UGM suspects an alien of doing devastating attacks on earth's cities, but the alien's true goals may actually be quite different.

videos.title: The Day When The Planets Align
videos.overview: An unidentified object causes a solar eclipse. UGM investigates who launched the object, and discovers a lost civilization.

videos.title: S.O.S.!! Invasion Of The Space Amoeba
videos.overview: Space amoebas have killed everyone aboard the Space 7. Can UGM prevent the Space 7 and its deadly cargo from reaching Earth?

videos.title: The Planet Of Traitorous Androids
videos.overview: Aliens invite Earth to join the utopian Galactic Federation. UGM is suspicious of the aliens' offer.

videos.title: A Beautiful Challenger
videos.overview: Jun is a UGM trainee, who challenges Emi multiple times. But when an alien attacks, her ambition just might be too much..

videos.title: The Time Tunnel Shadow Warriors
videos.overview: Takeshi and Emi accidentally travel to an alternate dimension. Who is the princess that, somehow, looks exactly like Emi?

videos.title: Terror Of The White Devil
videos.overview: A deadly fluid kills at random, dissolving human bodies. What is this phenomenon's connection to the advanced Algo Aliens?

videos.title: Lullaby Of The Migratory Bird Monster
videos.overview: A monster egg hatches, and the baby monster imprints on Takeshi. UGM tries to keep the baby safe until it's old enough to fly away.

videos.title: Wrath Of The Monster Emperor
videos.overview: A crooked village chief hopes to attract tourists to his village with a monster scam. But then the real monster Kiyathi awakens...

videos.title: A Lost Friend in the Desert
videos.overview: A spy seems to be monitoring UGM's movements. Is the culprit one of the reporters who works with Sera?

videos.title: The Monster Seeds Flew
videos.overview: Mariko's sick mother loves flowers. When a strange seed lands in Mariko's garden, she tries to make it grow.

videos.title: Monster Ship From The Dark Sea
videos.overview: Strange accidents begin to occur in the Pacific Ocean. Will Akira's father make it home?

videos.title: The Monster Made By A Boy
videos.overview: A hospital reports a monster sighing to UGM. But when UGM arrives on the scene, the monster is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: I Caught A Weird Fish!
videos.overview: Osamu buys a strange fish on his way back from the beach. He puts it in his saltwater tank at home, and it begins to grow...

videos.title: The 99th Year Dragon God Festival
videos.overview: Every 99 years, the dragon gem must be polished at the Dragon God Festival. But this time, strange forces work to steal the gem.

videos.title: Go For It! Stag Beetle Wintering Team
videos.overview: UGM is on high alert, due to an inversion that causes mirages. But the monster Guwaganda attacks, fueled by a young boy's anger.

videos.title: Alien Baltan's Terrifying Zoo Operation
videos.overview: Children who won a contest get to tour UGM. Baltan appears to exploit the jealousy of a boy who didn't win.

videos.title: The Echoing Voice Of Father Of Ultra
videos.overview: No one believes Futoshi's father really saw a monster. Does a monster really lurk near Nakatsudai?

videos.title: I'm A Monster You Guys!
videos.overview: Some kids find a UFO. One of them swallows it, and then transforms into a monster.

videos.title: The Sumo Boy From The Mountains
videos.overview: The sumo spirit Sumo Boy has appeared, wishing only to wrestle. But if angered, he becomes the monster Jihibikirun!

videos.title: Don't You Wanna See The Zero Fighter Bird Monster?
videos.overview: Saitou's beloved remote controlled Zero Fighter plane goes missing. Is finding it worth an encounter with the monster Balebadon?

videos.title: Wow! The Godness Kannon Was Strong!
videos.overview: Two men seek a treasure buried beneath an ancient statue of Kannon. Why does young Nobuo hear Kannon calling out to him?

videos.title: The Female Warrior From The Planet Of Ultra
videos.overview: UGM investigates a spaceship crash and recovers a beautiful young woman with amnesia. Why do the Rattler Aliens pursue her?

videos.title: Fierce Fight! 80 Vs Ultraseven
videos.overview: A biker gang assaults a young boy who loves Ultraseven. Now, Ultraseven appears to torment the bikers.

videos.title: Alien Baltan's Endless Challenging Spirit
videos.overview: Masaya tries to hoax his friends with fake UFO photos. Or is he just a pawn of the Baltan Alien?

videos.title: Revival Of The Fearsome Red King
videos.overview: Children on a ski trip find a magic jar. The jar contains the genie Mahjin, who grants every wish!

videos.title: Be Careful Of The Evil Glove!!
videos.overview: Tadashi throws away his baseball glove after he loses a game. Does the glove resent Tadashi?

videos.title: The Speed Runner From Death Mountain
videos.overview: The Marathon Kid comes down from the mountains to race. But when he grows angry, he becomes the monster Idatenrun!

videos.title: 80's Greatest Pinch! Transform! Ultrawoman
videos.overview: Two monsters work together to overwhelm Ultraman 80. Can Yullian transform and save him?

videos.title: Ah! The Giraffes And Elephants All Turned To Ice!!
videos.overview: Cap wants UGM to defeat the monster Margodon on its own. Can UGM succeed without Ultraman 80's help?
